question: Does my employer have to offer a retirement plan, or a state-run IRA?

nuggets.text: Participation in RetirePath (the state IRA program) is mandatory for eligible employers.
nuggets.quote: Participation in the Program shall be mandatory for eligible employers. Eligible employers shall enroll in the Program in accordance with the timeline established by the Plan.

nuggets.text: Eligible employers have five or more eligible employees and no qualified plan.
nuggets.quote: that employed five or more eligible employees for the period ending December 31 of the preceding calendar year prior to the Program's open enrollment period for that calendar year.

nuggets.text: The Commonwealth Savers Plan sponsors and administers the program.
nuggets.quote: The Program shall be sponsored and administered by the Plan.

nuggets.text: Enrollment began July 1, 2023; the Board sets the rollout deadlines.
nuggets.quote: The Program shall be established and enrollment of eligible employers shall begin on July 1, 2023, or as soon thereafter as practicable.

nuggets.text: Penalties for noncompliance may not exceed $200 per eligible employee a year.
nuggets.quote: Procedures for noncompliance with this chapter, including development of enforcement mechanisms and penalties not to exceed $200 per eligible employee annually;
